description: Record the customer's answer on an Angebot or Kostenvoranschlag of the connected facturo account: accepted, declined, or open again when it was set by mistake. Same switch as at facturo.at; nothing is sent to the client and the document stays unchanged. It takes the offer_number from get_recent_offers, and the change can be undone the same way. Creating an invoice or an Auftragsbestätigung from an offer marks it accepted by itself; an Auftragsbestätigung has no status.

offer_number.description: From get_recent_offers or a finalize result, e.g. AN-2026-0012

name: set_offer_status
title: Angebotsstatus setzen
